partner_result.result: two-sided relative-resonance stability and exact whitened carrier identity

new_result.statement: For full-column-rank M with g=s_m(M), arbitrary N, normalized relative action B=G^{-1/2}M^TNG^{-1/2}=H+K, D=I+H, resonance dimension q=dim 1_{(-rho,rho)}(D), and cross-sign skew block K_{+-}=P_+KP_-, if kappa_r=s_{r+1}(K_{+-}) and m-q-2r>=1, then s_{m-q-2r}(M+N)>=g(rho-kappa_r)_+. After any further coefficient tail of operator norm delta, subtract delta by Weyl.
new_result.mechanism: Within-sign skew blocks are free because their quadratic form vanishes against a definite sign block. Approximate only the opposite-sign skew block by rank r plus operator tail; the rank-r part spends at most 2r modes and the tail costs kappa_r.
new_result.survivor_obstruction: For tau<rho and r_tau=#{s_j(K_{+-})>tau}, a five-mode carrier surviving D_5 must satisfy q+2r_tau>=m-4 whenever g(rho-tau)>delta.

strict_family.property: K_{+-}=0 while ||K_L||=L tends to infinity; new theorem gives s_5=2 exactly. Partner r54 arbitrary-skew branch retains only 3 modes and global-skew branch is vacuous for L>=1.
strict_family.target_certificate: s_10(A_final)>=127/64>1, hence at least three eigenvalues have modulus >=1

unresolved_implication: From bare s_3(A)>=1, extract an original-coordinate quantitative carrier violating q+2r_tau>=m-4 at positive scale, or prove persistent failure forces an already-paid physical pair/projected crossing/grouped hub/ridge/Schur/common-plane exit. Do not use the refuted g_* scale-forcing shortcut.
dense_tail_safeguard: Tail used only through coefficient compression and singular-value Weyl; no uniformly-small random quadratic perturbation claim.
independence_safeguard: Whitening/sign decompositions are deterministic matrix devices; probabilistic receiver is applied only to literal original-coordinate banks.
continuity: C0 density proved only in the pinned D_5 branch; full-target continuity remains open.
